## Limitations

## PR Reviewer technical gate
- Verdict: Pending / PASS / CHANGES_REQUESTED / WAITING
- Reviewed head SHA / base SHA:
- Mergeability: clean / conflicting / unknown (source and observation time)
- Checks and evidence limits:
- Findings and Engineer follow-up:

Technical approval is separate from owner acceptance. New commits/base changes require re-review. With a shared author/reviewer identity, record the agent verdict as a comment; it is not a formal GitHub approval. This does not prevent the same identity from marking the PR ready or performing an authorized merge. State whether this PR completes the story or delivers a scoped partial result; partial merges do not close the story.

## Owner review gate
- [ ] Owner acceptance recorded for this revision

The PR Reviewer may mark ready and merge after technical PASS under the owner's standing authorization, when repository rules permit. Do not close the story or begin the next engineering story until the owner accepts the complete story and its implementation is merged. This checkbox is a reminder, not a substitute for owner-authored acceptance.

## Merge action
- Expected head SHA:
- Current base SHA / required checks / clean mergeability:
- Technical PASS and scoped completeness verified:
- Merge result (does not imply owner story acceptance):
